            <div class="qodef-content" >
                <div class="qodef-content-inner">
<div class="qodef-title-holder qodef-standard-type qodef-title-va-header-bottom" style="height: 200px;background-color: #111111" data-height="200">
		<div class="qodef-title-wrapper" style="height: 200px">
		<div class="qodef-title-inner">
			<div class="qodef-grid">
									<h1 class="qodef-page-title entry-title" >Kitesurfing Camp</h1>
											</div>
	    </div>
	</div>

<div class="qodef-container qodef-default-page-template">
		
	<div class="qodef-container-inner clearfix">
        					<div class="qodef-grid-row ">
				<div class="qodef-page-content-holder qodef-grid-col-12">
					<div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid" ><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid" ><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Kitesurfing Camp</h3>
<p>Cape Verde is an amazing place to learn and improve your kitesurfing and a great place to be on holiday either in a group or as a solo traveller. Our Kitesurfing Camp is the perfect way to experience kite surfing. Whatever your level is, our aim is to enhance your skills in a safe and enjoyable environment. You will love the vibe and the waves, we will make sure you have an amazing time with us!</p>
<h3 class="subtitle">Kitesurfing Camp Highlights</h3>
<ul>
<li>8 hours of PRIVATE kitesurf lessons (4 sessions)</li>
<li>IKO qualification</li>
<li>Sailing trip</li>
<li>Island tour</li>
<li>Transfers to and from airport</li>
<li>7 nights accommodation</li>
<li>Daily breakfast</li>
<li>Alternative activities for no wind days</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="subtitle">Kitesurfing Skill level</h3>
<ul>
<li>Beginner</li>
<li>Intermediate</li>
<li>Advanced</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div><strong>Instruction in English, French, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish</strong></div>
<div><strong> </strong></div>
<div class="listing-overview__airport" title="Airport transfer included: Amílcar Cabral International Airport" data-tooltip=""><strong><i class="ebs-icon ebs-icon-shuttle-included"></i> Airport transfer included: Amílcar Cabral International Airport</strong></div>
<div title="Airport transfer included: Amílcar Cabral International Airport" data-tooltip=""></div>
<div title="Airport transfer included: Amílcar Cabral International Airport" data-tooltip="">
<h3>Camp Facilities</h3>
<p>Misturod is in awesome location 30 seconds from the ocean and a two-minute walk to the centre. It is a simple, clean, comfortable, and friendly hotel with a good breakfast. All rooms have private bathrooms.</p>
<h3 class="title js-collapser">Kitesurfing Camp Program</h3>
<div class="listing-description-container js-collapsible" data-attr="lp-itinerary">
<p>Firstly, we will pick you up from the airport and take you to your accommodation. Each morning, the lessons start after breakfast (depending on the best tide for that day). Before you join the team for the camp, we will look at the forecast and pick the best times for lessons and practice.</p>
<div class="qodef-separator-holder clearfix  qodef-separator-center qodef-separator-normal">
	<div class="qodef-separator" ></div>
</div>

<p>Everyone is different &#8211; everyone learns at a different pace. During this holiday, there will be beginner, intermediate, and advanced lessons, including strapless lessons and equipment rental. Your instructors are IKO qualified, which means they have been trained on how to teach kitesurfing to an approved standard.</p>
<div class="qodef-separator-holder clearfix  qodef-separator-center qodef-separator-normal">
	<div class="qodef-separator" ></div>
</div>

<p>Our Kitesurfing Camp also provide an Island Tour and a Sailing trip for when you want a break from surfing. We have lots of solo travellers with us learning both kite and surf and its a great way to meet new people and have an amazing experience.</p>
</div>
<h3 class="title js-collapser collapsed">Included excursions</h3>
</div>
<div title="Airport transfer included: Amílcar Cabral International Airport" data-tooltip="">
<div class="listing-description-container js-collapsible" data-attr="lp-excursions">
<ul>
<li>Sailing Trip</li>
<li>Island Tour</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
